activity.notes: Angela Merkel became Federal Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany on 22 November 2005 and remained continuously in office through four cabinets until Olaf Scholz was elected and the Chancellery was handed over on 8 December 2021. ATLAS binds this completed chancellorship to the existing Federal Republic of Germany identity rather than the separate 1933-1945 German Reich polity.

sources.title: Dr. Angela Dorothea Merkel — Deutscher Bundestag
sources.citation_text: The German Bundestag biography states that Angela Merkel was Federal Chancellor from 22 November 2005.

sources.title: Election, appointment, swearing-in – the new Federal Government — Federal Government
sources.citation_text: The German Federal Government records Olaf Scholz's election as Federal Chancellor and Angela Merkel's handover of the Federal Chancellery on 8 December 2021.
